verdict.rationale: Codex is designed around natural-language task delegation—users describe tasks in plain language via CLI, IDE, or cloud, and Codex executes, summarizes, and opens PRs (codex-docs-5, codex-docs-6, codex-gh-1). Community evidence confirms heavy real-world use of this NL-driven workflow, though with mixed quality/performance complaints unrelated to the NL interface itself.
